capabilities: Maps repo folders to vault folders
Checks the repo branch for new commits
Lists new, changed, and removed files in a dialog
Protects locally edited files from overwrite
Moves removed repo files to system trash
disambiguation: Not a script runner; it only downloads plain template and script files and never executes them.
extras: Access token is stored in plain text in the plugin's data.json; GitHub only; without a token the API allows 60 requests per hour; no telemetry; no git install needed and works on mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep templates and scripts identical across vaults from a single GitHub source, so updates must be copied by hand.

relations.evidence: templates and scripts for Templater or QuickAdd
templates and scripts for Templater or QuickAdd

summary: One-way sync tool that maps GitHub repo folders to vault folders and asks before applying new, changed, or removed template and script files.
